Veterans Benefits: Kansas exempts military retired pay from state income tax; homestead property-tax refund for qualifying disabled veterans; beginning July 1 2026 a sales-tax exemption for 100% service-connected disabled veterans.
Description: Lawrence is a liberal college city in Douglas County anchored by the University of Kansas and Haskell Indian Nations University. The in-city VA clinic provides outpatient access and the Colmery-O'Neil VA Medical Center in Topeka is 27 miles west. Two defense-adjacent R&D firms (AeroVironment Innovation Center and DARcorporation) are present but the city is not a defense hub. Fort Leavenworth is 35 miles northeast. Housing is moderate for a university town and the combined sales-tax rate of 9.35% is notable. Property and overall crime run somewhat above the national average driven by university-area property crime.
